action.zero_wait_note: Documentation only: mix_report_sender.py treats --max-wait-seconds 0 as a 30-minute cap (ZERO_WAIT_CAP_SECONDS); when no report is ready by then it exits 4 with the report data day. An older report is sent with both the report data day and the current latest data day in the summary.

publication_contract.failure_action_note: Documentation of mix_report_sender.py: a report whose data day differs from the current latest data day is still sent; the summary shows the report data day and the current latest data day and records a newer_data_available/current_data_older_than_report label. Integrity, tamper (path/size/SHA-256), schema/run binding and ETF/non-ordinary exclusion failures raise MixReportIntegrityError and exit 2 without sending (fail closed). A report that is not ready yet is polled up to the zero-wait cap and then exits 4.

cutover_note: This definition is readiness-only. A separate operator must inspect existing tasks and perform any scheduler registration/cutover.
